systems: Kubernetes (every release's notes and artifacts are recorded by the release team, not inferred later from tags)
Terraform (a provider release is registered with its version and checksums before it is resolvable)
Nix (a channel update names the exact nixpkgs commit it was built from)
SLSA (provenance binds an artifact to the source revision that produced it)
crux.verdict: accept(the surveyed systems record a release when it is made and bind it to what it was built and qualified against. forjar's ledger is the same idea done late: v1.30.0 went out undeclared, and its cookbook was never bumped to it.
